basic_info.description: This chic Manhattan-style townhome offers exceptional living in a stunning setting. Featuring 2 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, and a den, this residence spans over 1,550 sq. ft. across two levels. Rarely available, this luxurious townhome at One Rincon Hill combines the convenience and comfort of a single-family home with the vibrant community atmosphere. As one of only four homes with this unique floor plan, it boasts 2 private entrances and a private balcony with breathtaking city views. The open and gracious layout is perfect for entertaining and contemporary living.  Residents enjoy full-service amenities, including valet parking, a dedicated concierge, a state-of-the-art fitness center, an elegant hospitality room, an outdoor pool deck, a BBQ area, and a serene reflection pool. Exclusive access to The Harrison and the private Uncle Harry's Penthouse lounge further enhances the living experience. Ideally located near Spear St., major tech headquarters, the Transbay Terminal, and just steps from the Ferry Building, Giants stadium, and the city's finest dining, this residence epitomizes luxury, convenience, and vibrant city living.
